from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter

W,H=1280,720
original=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/'first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))

cx0,cy0=724.105,125.851
rx0,ry0=139.55,150.76

    q=max(t-hit,0)
    xx=cx0+29*(1-np.exp(-q*2.0))
    xx+=2.0*np.sin(8*q)*np.exp(-2*q) if q>0 else 0

    compression=0.
